author: Thermetrics
versionDescription: Fixed a bug where every submission landed in 'Pending' instead of 'Received', silently skipping the already-configured team announcement for new feedback. The form now also requires a trip reference (invalid-link screen if missing) and auto-fills the submitter's name/email from the Trip's linked Client Contact Person (falling back to Client Contact Email, then a manual field) instead of leaving every submission anonymous — critical for following up on a bad review and for the planned auto-send feature, which needs a real email address to send to.
